slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

voice memos to yourself

record a 2 minute voice memo every night about your day and listen back on sunday. hearing your own voice without cringing is a skill, and it starts the day you stop skipping it.

the full stop

end every sentence this week without "you know?" or "if that makes sense". when you stop asking for permission at the end of your thoughts, people stop doubting them too.

public sketching

sit in a park once a week and draw what you see for 20 minutes, badly. doing something you're bad at in front of strangers is the fastest way to stop needing their approval.

five minute lessons

every morning, take 5 minutes to learn one thing about art, history or science. the person who always has something interesting to say never has to fight for a place in the conversation.
slides.texte_sophia:
five minute lessons

every morning, take 5 minutes to learn one thing about art, history or science. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and having something to say gives you a quiet confidence anywhere.

slides.texte_overlay:
unplanned saturdays

once a month, wake up with zero plans and follow whatever sounds interesting. trusting yourself to fill a whole day is the same muscle as trusting yourself in a room full of people.
